rows.label: Chipset

rows.value:

Intel Celeron processors in the LGA1700 package
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for CPU support list.

rows.value:
Supports Dual Channel DDR5 - 6000+(OC) MT/s, Non-ECC, Un-buffered ,Clocked Unbuffered DIMM (CUDIMM) Memory
 
4 x DDR5 DIMM Memory Slot, Max. Supports up to 256 GB Memory
 
Support Intel® Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory modules
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for Memory support list.

rows.value:
Supports DX12
Supports HDCP

Supports M.2 Type 2280 SSD module
 
Supports PCIe 4.0 x4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe SSD
